long_biography.plain_text:
Airport Inn, Inc. operated a full-service hotel opposite Milwaukee's airport. Rupena served as company president while his wife, Sharon, held an ownership or officer role. Under the Clarion name, the property combined 180 rooms with banquet, restaurant, lounge and conference facilities. Employees later described the Rupena family as owners for 25 years.

Beyond lodging, the hotel supported community events and small businesses. Fitness entrepreneur Michael Sweeney credits Rupena with offering him space during the gym's early development, helping turn a home project into a commercial operation. The Rupenas' operating chapter ended when an investment group acquired the property in 2015. It remained under the Clarion brand before conversion to Four Points by Sheraton.
